name: Laws of the Republic of Nauru (Constitution and Public Service Act 2016)

record_note: The Constitution of Nauru 1968 and the Public Service Act 2016 from the RONLAW reprints of the Laws of the Republic of Nauru: each act from its earliest reprint on RONLAW (consolidated to 2022-06-08 and 2022-06-10) to the latest (2026-07-20); checked 2026-10-28.

dates.commit: in-force (the operative date printed in the history note, else the commencement in the Table of Amendments, else the reprint's consolidation date)

default_reach.meaning: a written law does not commence retrospectively unless it clearly says so, and a repeal or amendment does not affect the previous operation of the law, rights acquired or accrued, or proceedings already begun under it
default_reach.authority: Interpretation Act 2011 (Nauru), sections 22(3) and 28(1); section 21: a provision commences at the beginning of its day
